title: Sara Duterte ‘honest enough’ to declare ‘untraceable investments’ in SALN: Panelo
summary: Vice President Sara Duterte was “honest enough” to declare in her statements of assets, liabilities and net worth (SALN) an otherwise “untraceable investment,” her spokesperson said on Wednesday.
